about: Mod ping-pong round 7 (docs/design/mod-pingpong.md#ronda-7-289-las-preguntas-de-la-búsqueda-hacia-afuera): the outward-search ASKs Elias approved on 28 September. Mystical Agradditions' insanium tier and its star, egg, draconium and nitro seeds open in Act VI (pingpong7 family of tools/generate_family_balance.py); ME Beam Former comes without its uncapped energy tower; Hardcore Revival adds a co-op downed state. Animus is deferred: its bound spear still crashes multiplayer clients in 5.2.13 (TeamDman/Animus#156).

mysticalagradditions: The sixth Mystical Agriculture tier: insanium essence, cruxes and seeds for Nether stars, dragon eggs, awakened draconium and nitro crystals, plus Nether and End ores

Insanium comes only from the master-crystal fusion of supremium blocks, which takes the Nature Luminosity (Act VI); the four-essence route is removed, so every seed and crux that needs insanium waits for Act VI
me_beam_former: Visible beams that carry an ME network up to 32 blocks through the air
Native: a beam only carries the channels its network has, and the controller takes the distribution matrix (Act III); the uncapped wireless energy tower is removed

qol.hardcorerevival: A player at zero health is knocked out for two minutes instead of dying, and a teammate can rescue them; off in single player and when alone on a server
